tooltip.essentialcraft5.shade_core.desc.en: Condensed in an enrichment chamber built where shade gathers. Needed for the SHADE Corrupted Crystal Pillar, the Calamity Beacon and the higher matrix ranks.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.shade_core.desc.zh: 在暗影聚集的地方用富集仓坍缩出来的。暗渎水晶柱、天灾信标和更高的矩阵阶都要它。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.demon_oath.desc.en: What a demon gives you when you swear the oath to it. Needed for the Calamity Beacon.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.demon_oath.desc.zh: 你向恶魔立誓时它给你的东西。天灾信标要用。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Collapsing: the chamber stands at a shade site with Umbral Crystals inside, so it will condense a Shade Core.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 正在坍缩：仓在暗影地点，外壳里有影晶，会凝出暗影核心。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.en: Condensing paused: the chamber is making a Shade Core first.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.co.zh: 凝结停着：这座仓正在凝暗影核心。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.sh.en: Shade Core: Umbral Crystals only work here if the chamber is in the Shadow Corrupted Land or within %s blocks of it.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.sh.zh: 暗影核心：仓要建在暗影腐化之地，或离它 %s 格以内，影晶才用得上。

message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.sh.en: Shade Core: this is a shade site. Umbral Crystals inside the shell: %s of %s.
message.essentialcraft5.ec_controller.sh.zh: 暗影核心：这里是暗影地点，外壳里的影晶 %s / %s 个。

gui.essentialcraft5.demon_standing.perk..en: Sneak and right-click a demon you summoned while holding Umbral Crystals to hand over %s of them and swear the oath for a Demon's Oath
gui.essentialcraft5.demon_standing.perk..zh: 潜行时手持影晶右键你召出的恶魔，交出 %s 个影晶立誓，换一个恶魔之誓

message.essentialcraft5.demon_oath.not_s.en: Only the one who summoned this demon can swear the oath to it.
message.essentialcraft5.demon_oath.not_s.zh: 只有召出这只恶魔的人能向它立誓。

message.essentialcraft5.demon_oath.stand.en: You need %s Demonic Renown to swear the oath; you have %s.
message.essentialcraft5.demon_oath.stand.zh: 立誓要契约之誉 %s，你现在是 %s。

message.essentialcraft5.demon_oath.cryst.en: Swearing the oath takes %s Umbral Crystals; you carry %s.
message.essentialcraft5.demon_oath.cryst.zh: 立誓要交 %s 个影晶，你身上只有 %s 个。

message.essentialcraft5.demon_oath.done.en: The demon takes %s Umbral Crystals, hands you a Demon's Oath and leaves.
message.essentialcraft5.demon_oath.done.zh: 恶魔收下 %s 个影晶，给了你一个恶魔之誓，然后离开了。

message.essentialcraft5.matrix_projectio.en: Your matrix is shade now, but shade affinity only takes effect from %s.
message.essentialcraft5.matrix_projectio.zh: 你的矩阵变成了暗影属性，不过暗影相性要到%s才生效。

structure.essentialcraft5.player_pentacl.en: Base of a tier 4 crystal pillar (SHADE Corrupted)
